product_demonstrations.reason: Isolated read-only published Beta snapshot opens locally, but map view has nine missing tiles due to external HTTPS net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID. No working map-backed flow verified; no app footage used.
product_demonstrations.repository_findings: Repository contains beta overrides/assets; workflow composes actual app from baseline source. Artifact download was denied; verified HTTPS published static assets mirrored byte-for-byte for isolated local preview, without edits.
product_demonstrations.certificate_findings: Chromium rejected the environment proxy certificate (issuer openai.com), while HTTPS clients using configured CA trust succeeded. Correct configured CA identity was checked and imported into an isolated temporary NSS database using documented certutil procedures; Chromium still rejected it. No global trust changes, invalid-certificate exceptions or verification bypasses used.
product_demonstrations.privacy: No sign-in, real personal locations, production-data entry, app repository changes or user-data modification. Local test browser/profile and cached files are disposable.
